source_text: However, by 2007, Al-Azhar's Grand Mufti Ali Gomaa declared FGM forbidden (haram) as it contravenes Islamic principles against harming the body without medical necessity, a stance echoed in broader scholarly debates rejecting any obligatory status. [21]
